description: This Java source file defines the ImmutableEntry class, which implements an immutable key-value pair with additional matching logic, used within the mockserver project.

classes.name: ImmutableEntry
classes.description: An immutable key-value pair class with matching and comparison logic, used in mockserver for request matching.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Static factory methods to create ImmutableEntry instances with either String or NottableString keys.

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Checks if the key is optional.

methods.name: isNotted
methods.description: Checks if the key is marked as 'not' and the value is not 'not'.

methods.name: isNotOptional
methods.description: Checks if the key is not optional.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException as the entry is immutable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the entry.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on regex matching of key and value, considering optional keys.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on key and value.

methods.name: listsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two lists are equal element-wise.

methods.name: listsEqualWithOptionals
methods.description: Checks list equality considering optional entries and regex matching.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Helper method to check if a set of keys contains a match based on regex.
